name: For each item
description: Loops over an array (passengers, segments, bundles…). Downstream nodes run once per item, with the current item available as $pax / $bound / etc.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Which list to loop over — pick an array from your request (passengers, journeys, bundles, segments, etc.).

params.name: as
params.description: What name to call each item inside the loop. Downstream nodes refer to the current item as $<this name> (e.g. $pax.id).

enum.label: pax
enum.description: Best when iterating passengers — read fields as $pax.id, $pax.paxType, …

enum.label: item
enum.description: Generic catch-all when none of the above fit.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Per-element pass — fires once per array element.
